findings: Adapter imports no fs/child_process/process — pure string/number functions; nowMs injected.
Loader uses existsSync + readFileSync ONLY; no write/append/unlink/rename/spawn/exec/kill anywhere.
State selection keys on reachability/DNS/staleness booleans only; latency appears only in recentLatency (reported, never compared to change state).
Default path resolves to %LOCALAPPDATA%/EOS/netwatch/... and is overridable via EOS_NETWATCH_CSV; no hard-coded repo path.
